levels.name: Recruit
levels.privilege: Can Download; Can rescue 5 torrents per day until 25 pending completion; Members in this class are capped at receiving 1,000 BP in gifts/tips per member.

levels.name: User
levels.privilege: Can Request Reseeds; Can Request Torrents; Can Remove HNRs (with BP); Bypass Upload Moderation; Change Avatar;Can rescue 6 torrents per day until 30 pending completion.

levels.name: Member
levels.privilege: View Workhouse; View Internals; View Staff; View Site Stats; Change Title; Change About; Change Signature; Can rescue 10 torrents per day until 30 pending completion.

levels.name: Expert
levels.privilege: Send Invites; View Torrent Peers; View Torrent History; Change Profile Cover; Can rescue 11 torrents per day until 33 pending completion.

levels.name: Pro
levels.privilege: View Invite Forum; View Chat History; Can rescue 12 torrents per day until 36 pending completion.

levels.name: Elite
levels.privilege: Can rescue 15 torrents per day until 45 pending completion. Receive 2 FL token(s) for every 30 days this class is retained.

levels.name: Master
levels.privilege: View Torrent Changes; View Movie / TV Edits; Can rescue 16 torrents per day until 48 pending completion. Receive 2 FL token(s) for every 30 days this class is retained. Receive 25% discount on all downloads.

levels.name: King
levels.privilege: Edit Movie / TV Details; Can rescue 20 torrents per day until 60 pending completion. Receive 2 FL token(s) for every 30 days this class is retained. Receive 50% discount on all downloads.

levels.name: Emperor
levels.privilege: Can rescue 40 torrents per day until 120 pending completion. Receive 5 FL token(s) for every 30 days this class is retained. Receive 1 invite(s) for every 30 days this class is retained. Receive 100% discount on all downloads.
